human_population_constraints.interpretation: Both observed human rankings are strict, so a candidate can satisfy the ranking condition.

An observed human outcome ranking contains a tie. Under the stipulated strict-order decision rule, no candidate assessed on this population can qualify, regardless of forecast accuracy or IE. This constraint is not evidence that calibrated behavior is inaccurate.

D1.ordering_note: Each comparison follows the actual human mean ordering; any human tie fails the strict-order condition.
